headline: Entity virtual slot 0FCh is not empty. 92 of the 94 entity classes in the image - every ship, gun platform and projectile - share 00432480, which appends `this` to the caller's vector. Only two classes override it: MAirfield (006D4DD0, its intact hangars) and the plane squadron (007F44E0, its live planes). docs/GAME_EXECUTABLE.md records the opposite in three places and is wrong; the empty sub-entity list is an artefact of the reconstruction's host, not of the native code.

slot.argument: the caller's pointer vector; the gunnery tick passes this+0BCh (kUnitGunneryOffSubEntityScratch) after clearing it with 0063BCD0
slot.evidence: both call sites load [vtable+0FCh] and PUSH the vector; all three implementations end RET 4; the only data reference to each override is vtable+0FCh (00CF8D04 = 00CF8C08+0FCh, 00D088BC = 00D087C0+0FCh)

vtable_census.method: scan .text for `mov dword ptr [reg], imm32` with mod=00 and an .rdata immediate - the store of a vtable at object+0, which is the pointer MOV EDX,[ECX] loads at the call site; keep the immediates that begin a run of more than 63 .text pointers; read [start+0FCh]; attribute the class from the storing function
completeness: the dword 00432480 occurs 92 times in .rdata and every occurrence is at exactly +0FCh from a primary vtable start; no other vtable offset uses it
Ghidra xrefs for 00432480 are 92 [DATA] references and no code reference; 006D4DD0 has exactly one xref (00CF8D04 = 00CF8C08+0FCh) and 007F44E0 exactly one (00D088BC = 00D087C0+0FCh)
the alternate store form `mov r32, imm32; mov [reg], r32` occurs 27 times in .text and none of its immediates begins a run longer than 3 .text pointers, so none is a vtable
vtable_census.rtti: none usable: the dword before a vtable is not a complete-object locator and an RTTI-anchored scan finds zero vtables with 64 or more slots
